pokedexEntries.rb: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

pokedexEntries.la: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.
